integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action fantasy realism, cinematic, a low-angle close shot frames a teenage girl's bare feet standing in dew-covered grass on a windswept hilltop at dawn. She wears a faded green windbreaker and rolled-up jeans, and her toes curl into the wet soil as pale golden feathers push out through the skin above her ankles, unfurling into two small feathered wings. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the wings twitch once, then spread wide, scattering droplets of dew into the low sun. Her fingers grip the grass, and a wide shot opens behind her to reveal an empty valley and a cliff edge dropping into morning haze. [Shot 2] At 00:03.400, the camera cuts to a tracking shot from behind as she sprints three strides across the hilltop and leaps from the cliff edge, her ankle wings snapping open at full span. The camera tracks her descent and lift with large amplitude at fast speed, dropping alongside her as she falls, then rises again on the second wingbeat. Her windbreaker whips and flattens against her back, her arms spread wide, and her hair streams upward as the ground pulls away beneath her feet and the valley opens into miles of green fields, gravel roads and scattered farmhouses. [Shot 3] At 00:07.200, the shot transitions to a high aerial wide shot as the camera arcs around her with large amplitude at slow speed. She levels out far above a patchwork of farmland that gives way to dry plains, then to red canyon country carved by a winding river. Her shadow flickers across the ridges below, and her ankle wings beat in a steady rhythm while a flock of geese forms loosely around her and drifts apart again. She tilts her body into a long glide, one wing angled down, and the landscape slides past in wide bands of green, ochre and rust. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a wide aerial shot trailing behind her as she drops toward a coastline at sunset, banks hard over the water, and rises again toward a bank of lit clouds. Below her, a dense city skyline glows along the shore with bridges and towers catching the last orange light, and the ocean runs to the horizon in long dark ridges. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed as her wings catch an updraft; she spreads her arms, levels her feet behind her, and climbs into the warm sky until her silhouette shrinks against the clouds.

overall_soundscape: Wind sweeps steadily across the hilltop while grass rustles against her bare feet. Feathers unfurl with a soft papery crackle, followed by a quick intake of breath and a quiet, startled laugh. Her feet pound the dry dirt for three strides before the ground falls silent, then air rushes past in a continuous roar cut by deep wingbeats and the flapping snap of her jacket. Cold high-altitude wind hums as distant geese call in loose, ragged choruses, and the sound softens to a steady coastal breeze with faint waves breaking far below.

non_diegetic_music: A solo cello line at a slow tempo, joined by rising string harmonics and a low brass swell; full strings and a driving percussion pulse enter at a fast tempo with the melody lifting upward, thin into sustained high notes over a light repeating piano figure, then return at a broad slow tempo and fade to a single sustained note at the end.

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a wide shot from slightly above the street, showing the market at full bustle: baskets nearly emptied, shoppers moving between stalls with full tote bags, vendors making change and bagging produce. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed as more people enter the aisle, the trestle tables and the "Fresh Peaches" sign settle into the final composition, and the morning light brightens across the crowd.

overall_soundscape: Wooden crates scrape and thud against the pavement while cloth flutters and produce rolls into baskets. source_prompt: People gather on a peaceful beach at sunset, a bonfire crackling as they sit around, enjoying the warmth and the sight of the sun dipping below the horizon.

A group of five friends walks in from the left side of the frame carrying driftwood and a folded blanket, their long shadows stretching toward the water. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as two of them drop the wood into a loose pile above the tideline, a third kneels beside it and strikes a lighter, and a small flame catches the dry twigs and grows into a crackling bonfire. The others unfold the blanket and settle onto the sand in a loose semicircle around the fire, facing the water. [Shot 2] At 00:05.500, the camera cuts to a medium shot at fire height, flames filling the left of the frame as sparks lift and drift out over the sand. The young woman in a gray knit sweater with a warm, relaxed voice (S1) leans toward the fire with her hands spread to the heat and says: <d>[English] We should do this every year.</d> The man beside her in a dark jacket laughs and nudges the wood with a stick, sending a brief flare of embers upward, and the group shifts closer as the light flickers across their faces. [Shot 3] At 00:10.400, the shot cuts to a low angle behind the seated group, their backs and shoulders rendered as dark silhouettes against the glowing sky. The camera holds a static shot as the sun's lower edge touches the water, flattens, and sinks until only a thin sliver of light remains on the horizon line, while the bonfire glow pulses warmly across the sand and the group's heads lean together toward the view. The last of the sun disappears at the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape: Gentle waves break and slide up the sand in a slow, repeating wash beneath a light ocean breeze. The bonfire crackles and pops steadily as wood settles, with sparks hissing out, and soft laughter, murmured voices, and the rustle of a blanket accompany footsteps shifting on dry sand.

non_diegetic_music: Warm fingerpicked acoustic guitar at a slow tempo, joined by sustained low strings and a soft frame drum that swells gently before fading out as the sun disappears.

source_prompt: Monks meditate in a serene mountaintop temple, sitting in quiet reflection as the wind gently moves through the surrounding trees, creating a sense of peace and tranquility.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide high-angle shot looks down over a small stone temple built on a mountain ridge, where two rows of monks in deep red and maroon robes sit cross-legged on woven cushions across a swept flagstone courtyard, hands folded in their laps, spines straight, eyes closed. Thin dawn light rakes across the tiles, mist drifts below the ridge among dark pines, and the wind pushes through the branches so they sway slowly and the loose edges of the robes lift and settle. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed along the courtyard, passing the nearest shoulders as the monks hold their posture without moving. [Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of an elderly monk's face in profile, his shaved head, weathered skin, and closed eyes filling the frame while his breath forms faint vapor in the cold thin air; behind him the remaining rows of monks remain seated and still. The camera arcs slowly around him from his right side as the two rows of monks (S1,S2) begin a low chant together, their chests barely rising, <d>[Sanskrit] ॐ मणि पद्मे हूँ</d> repeated under their breath, the sound carrying over the courtyard stones. [Shot 3] At 00:08.500, the shot transitions to a close-up of a single incense stick standing in a bronze bowl, a thin gray thread of smoke rising and bending toward the left in the breeze; a wrist wrapped with worn wooden prayer beads rests beside the bowl, fingers loose and unmoving. The camera pans right with small amplitude at slow speed along the front row of seated monks, catching clasped hands, faded robe folds, and the brass chime hanging from the eave turning gently above them. [Shot 4] At 00:11.500, the camera pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed, lifting away from the courtyard until the whole temple appears on the peak, its curved tiled roof and the row of seated monks small against the stone; mist slides through the valley below, the pines on the slope continue to lean and spring back in the wind, and a few birds cross the pale sky as the monks remain motionless in their meditation until the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape: A steady mountain wind moves through the pine branches over the temple, mixed with softer gusts across the flagstones and the faint rustle of heavy robes. Wooden prayer beads click once against a wrist, the incense stick taps lightly in its bronze bowl, and a small brass eave chime rings at irregular intervals. Distant birds call once or twice from the valley below, and the monks' slow, low breathing stays audible throughout.

non_diegetic_music: A sustained low string drone at a very slow tempo, joined by widely spaced struck bell tones and a soft bowed note that swells gently in the middle before fading out beneath the wind.

Boots scrape and crunch over gravel and grit, fabric rustles with each step, and the explorer's slow breathing is audible as the flashlight casing clicks faintly in their grip.

non_diegetic_music: A sustained low string drone at a slow tempo with sparse, widely spaced piano tones that swell slightly as the wider panel of paintings is revealed, then hold steady.

source_prompt: Snow gently falls outside as someone stokes the roaring fireplace in a cozy mountain lodge, adding logs to keep the flames dancing and casting flickering shadows across the room.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a stone hearth inside a timber-walled mountain lodge, with a snow-dusted window visible at the left edge of the frame and deep blue evening light beyond the glass. A woman in her thirties wearing a thick oatmeal wool sweater and dark trousers kneels on a braided rug in front of the fire, her sleeves pushed to her elbows. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she lifts a split birch log from the stack beside her, sets it onto the glowing bed of coals, and nudges it into place with a black iron poker. Orange light climbs over the fresh wood and the flames rise higher. [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of the fire itself, filling the frame with curling flame, white-hot coals, and the charred ends of two logs. The poker tip slides back out of the hearth and out of frame to the right. Flames wrap around the new log, tightening and stretching as resin bubbles at its edge and small embers lift and drift upward past the top of the frame. [Shot 3] At 00:09.000, the shot transitions to a wide shot of the room from behind the seating area, showing the woman settling back onto her heels and resting the poker against the stone, while long flickering shadows sweep across the log walls, the leather armchair, and the timber ceiling beams. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed, revealing the frosted window where snow continues to fall past the pane. The woman with a low, warm voice (S1) says: <d>[English] That should hold until morning.</d> She tucks a loose strand of hair behind her ear and holds her open palms toward the flames.

overall_soundscape: A fire crackles continuously with sharp pops and the low rush of moving air, while a fresh log scrapes across stone and settles with a soft thud. Wind presses faintly against the window glass, and the room stays otherwise quiet apart from the rustle of a wool sweater and the dull clink of iron being set down on stone.

non_diegetic_music: A slow fingerpicked acoustic guitar figure over sustained low strings, joined midway by a sparse piano line and soft brushed percussion that gradually decrease in volume through the final seconds.

source_prompt: A couple sits at a peaceful lakeside picnic, occasionally reaching into a basket for food, while the gentle ripples on the lake reflect the shifting colors of the sky.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot frames a couple in their early thirties seated on a cream-and-red checked blanket on a grassy bank at the edge of a calm lake, a wicker basket and two enamel plates set between them. The woman, wearing a rust-orange linen shirt with rolled sleeves, sits with her knees drawn up; the man in a faded blue henley leans back on one elbow. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the woman lifts the basket lid, takes out a round loaf, and tears it in half, handing one piece across the blanket. The man takes it and nods toward the water. Drifting low over the lake surface, thin ripples carry blocks of pale gold and soft slate blue while the sky overhead shifts gradually from warm afternoon light toward amber. The woman with a warm, low voice (S1) says: <d>[English] It's turning gold already.</d> The man answers with a light, unhurried voice (S2): <d>[English] Give it ten minutes.</d> [Shot 2] At 00:05.500, the shot cuts to a close-up at blanket level as the man's hand reaches into the open basket, shifts two apples aside, and closes around a small jar of preserves; he twists the lid open while the woman's fingers pinch a cherry from a shallow bowl. The camera drifts right with small amplitude at slow speed, sliding past the basket rim to the water a few meters away, where overlapping ripples flatten and re-form, each crest holding a copper streak from the descending sun and a violet band from the higher clouds. Behind the couple, reeds bend and straighten in the breeze, and the lake's surface color deepens by a visible degree across the shot. [Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a wider view from slightly above and behind the couple, framing them small against the water and the horizon. The camera holds a static shot as they pack the plates and the loaf back into the basket, then sit shoulder to shoulder facing the lake. The sky has cooled to rose and indigo, and the ripples now break those colors into short, shifting horizontal strokes that reach nearly to the near shore. The woman rests her head against the man's shoulder, and both stay still as the last light narrows to a bright line along the far treeline.

overall_soundscape: Gentle water laps in slow, overlapping waves against the grassy bank, with a light breeze moving through reeds and nearby leaves. Fabric and blanket rustle as the couple shifts position, the wicker basket creaks, a jar lid unscrews with a soft metallic rasp, and bread crusts crack faintly. Distant ducks call once or twice across the lake, and quiet breathing and a soft shared laugh sit close to the microphone.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse acoustic-guitar arpeggio at a slow tempo, joined halfway through by sustained warm strings that slowly rise in volume, then thin out to a single reverberant guitar note as the light fades.

source_prompt: Travelers hurry through a bustling airport terminal, pulling luggage behind them as flight information boards update with the latest departures and arrivals.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot frames a sunlit airport terminal where crowds of travelers stream along a polished concourse beneath a long glass wall. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed alongside a man in a gray coat who pulls a black rolling suitcase, its wheels leaving a soft trail across the reflective floor; around him, a woman in a red scarf lifts a carry-on onto her shoulder, two teenagers jog past with backpacks, and a line of passengers bunches at a gate desk. A female announcer's voice (S1), off-screen, slightly compressed and echoing through the hall, says: <d>[English] Final call for flight 287 to Lisbon.</d> Heads turn toward the gates along the far side of the hall. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of a large flight information board overhead, its glossy panel reading "DEPARTURES" above rows of white text and "ARRIVALS" below, the reflected silhouettes of passing travelers sliding across the screen. Individual rows flicker and re-sort upward as new times and gate numbers replace the old ones, and in the blurred foreground a suitcase wheel rolls past the edge of the frame.

overall_soundscape: A wide, echoing hall ambience carries layered footsteps and the continuous rumble of suitcase wheels over polished stone. Indistinct conversation, a distant boarding chime, and the muffled reverb of the public-address system blend beneath the movement of the crowd.

non_diegetic_music: A steady mid-tempo pulse with light hand percussion and a repeating two-note synth pattern, rising slightly in volume as the board updates and fading out at the end.

source_prompt: Waves gently roll onto the shore as someone walks along the edge of the water, their footprints being washed away with each retreating wave in the crystal-clear sea.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot frames a long curve of pale sand meeting crystal-clear turquoise water under a low afternoon sun. Small waves roll in one after another and spread thin across the wet sand in slow, even sweeps. A barefoot walker in a light linen shirt with rolled-up trousers moves along the very edge of the water from left to right at an unhurried, steady pace. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping the walker on the right side of the frame while the shoreline slides past behind them. Each incoming wave rises around their ankles and then retreats, smoothing the sand where they stepped. [Shot 2] At 00:07.500, the shot cuts to a low, ground-level close-up of the wet sand just behind the walker's feet. A line of fresh footprints presses into the glossy surface, their edges dark with moisture. A thin sheet of water slides in from the top of the frame, curls around the heel marks, then pulls back, foam and sand grains dragging the depressions flatter until only a faint shallow trace and a wet sheen remain. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the last ripple drains away. [Shot 3] At 00:11.500, the shot cuts to a medium-wide view from behind as the walker continues along the water's edge, now further down the beach. The camera tracks their back at slow speed. One more wave spreads around their ankles and draws back across the smoothed sand, leaving the beach unmarked while sunlight glints on the shallow water.

overall_soundscape: Gentle waves roll onto the shore in repeating sweeps, breaking with soft wet hisses and draining back with light gurgles. Bare feet press into wet sand with muffled thuds, and distant gulls call over a low sea breeze that continues through the whole scene.

non_diegetic_music: Warm acoustic-guitar arpeggios at a slow tempo, joined by sustained soft strings that rise slightly in the middle section and gradually fade out at the end.

source_prompt: Visitors move through the grand cathedral, light streaming through stained glass windows and casting colorful patterns on the floor as they gaze up at the high ceilings.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide establishing shot frames the nave of a grand stone cathedral, where tall columns rise toward ribbed vaults and shafts of sunlight pour through tall stained-glass windows on the right wall, scattering red, blue, and gold patches across the worn flagstone floor. A small group of visitors walks slowly up the central aisle in the middle distance, dressed in muted coats and scarves, their heads tilted back as they take in the height above them. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed along the aisle, letting two visitors pass close to the lens while dust motes drift visibly inside the light beams. [Shot 2] At 00:02.800, the camera tilts up with large amplitude at slow speed, sweeping from the floor toward the high vaulted ceiling, where the colored light from the windows climbs across carved stone ribs and a painted clerestory. In the lower edge of the frame, three visitors come to a halt and stare upward, one of them raising a hand to shade their eyes from the glare. [Shot 3] At 00:04.300, the camera cuts to a low close-up of the flagstone floor, where overlapping pools of crimson, sapphire, and amber light tremble slightly as a pair of dark shoes steps carefully between them, then stops.

overall_soundscape: Footsteps and slow, scuffing soles echo across the long stone floor of the cathedral, layered over a low room ambience of soft, indistinct visitor chatter and the faint creak of wooden pews. A heavy door closes far behind the camera, and a brief rustle of coats and a quiet exhale accompany the moment the visitors stop and look up.

non_diegetic_music: Sustained organ chords at a slow tempo with a deep, steady pedal tone underneath, joined by sparse high string notes that gradually fade as the footsteps halt.

source_prompt: The couple runs hand in hand to release a sky lantern, then watches it drift upward into the night sky, carried by the wind with the stars shining above.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide tracking shot follows a young couple from behind as they run hand in hand across an open grassy field toward a low stone clearing, the tall grass sweeping against their ankles under a deep blue night sky scattered with stars. The woman in a pale knitted sweater holds a folded paper sky lantern against her chest with her free hand, and the man in a dark jacket keeps pace beside her, glancing back at her with a grin. The camera tracks right with small amplitude at normal speed, staying level with their strides as the grass parts around them, and the young woman with a bright, slightly breathless voice (S1) calls out mid-stride: <d>[English] Almost there, don't drop it!</d> Their shadows stretch long over the ground from a distant warm glow behind them. [Shot 2] At 00:05.500, the shot cuts to a medium close-up as the couple comes to a stop on the flat stones and kneels facing each other. The man cups the lantern open while the woman flicks a lighter under its base, and the flame catches the paper with a soft orange bloom that lights both their faces from below. The camera holds a static shot as they rise together, lift the lantern above their heads, and release it; the paper shell swells and drifts free of their fingertips, and the young man with a low, warm voice (S2) murmurs: <d>[English] Go on, up you go.</d> [Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a wide low-angle shot from the grass, framing the couple as small silhouettes at the bottom of the frame with their heads tilted back and arms loosely lowered, and the glowing lantern rising steadily above them. The camera tilts up at slow speed and pushes in with small amplitude, following the lantern as the wind carries it sideways in a gentle arc across the star-filled sky, where it shrinks to a warm dot among the stars before the shot ends.

overall_soundscape: Steady wind moves through the tall grass with a continuous dry rustle underfoot as running footsteps thump across the field and slow into a stop on the stone slabs. Fabric shifts and paper crinkles while the lantern is opened, a lighter clicks and catches with a soft whoosh, and distant crickets and night insects hum beneath a faint fluttering of paper as the lantern lifts away.

non_diegetic_music: Warm sustained strings at a moderate tempo over a repeating piano figure, joined by a soft rising celesta line that swells gradually as the lantern ascends and then fades out with the final shot.

source_prompt: A woman practices yoga in a peaceful park, moving gracefully through a series of poses, focusing on balance and flexibility.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot frames a woman in gray athletic wear on a dark blue yoga mat in a peaceful park, tall trees and a low morning mist behind her; the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she presses her palms into the mat in a downward-facing dog, lifts her hips, and steps her right foot forward, rising smoothly into a warrior pose with her arms extended straight ahead. [Shot 2] At 00:03.200, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of her shifting her weight onto her left leg, drawing her right foot up against her inner thigh, and pressing her hands together above her head in a tree pose. The camera arcs right with small amplitude at slow speed around her torso as she sways slightly, fixes her gaze on a point between the trees, and lets a small exhale relax her shoulders, holding the balance until the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape: Sparse birdsong and a light breeze rustling leaves fill the park while a faint distant bicycle passes on a path. Her mat creaks softly under shifting weight, with steady audible exhales, one deep inhale, and the quiet brush of fabric as her arms move.

non_diegetic_music: Slow sustained pads with a single low flute line, joined by soft hand-percussion at a gentle tempo that thins to one held note in the final seconds.

source_prompt: A group of robots with mechanical limbs and sensors engage in a playful snowball fight, their precise throws and dodges showing unexpected agility as snowballs fly across the snowy field.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot frames an open snowy field backed by a line of bare birches under a flat overcast sky. Four robots with exposed mechanical limbs, hydraulic joints, and sensor arrays stand scattered across the snow: one with long segmented arms and a single glowing cyan visor, one on tripod legs with a rotating camera head, one low to the ground on a treaded base, and one bulky unit with piston shoulders. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed as the long-armed robot (S1), its synthesized voice flat and buzzing, calls out <d>[English] Incoming!</d> and whips its arm forward, launching a packed snowball in a flat arc across the field. The tripod robot pivots its head to track the projectile, its lens iris narrowing. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of two mechanical hands compressing a lump of snow into a dense sphere, snow crystals squeezing out between segmented metal fingers. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the fingers rotate the snowball, calibrate, and release; the arm snaps forward at fast speed and the ball leaves the frame. Behind it, the glowing cyan visor reflects the incoming white shape and the robot's torso twists sharply to the side. [Shot 3] At 00:08.500, the camera cuts to a low-angle shot near the snow surface as the thrown snowball streaks in. The treaded robot skids sideways on its base, spraying powder, and the snowball bursts against its rear plating in a white cloud. The camera arcs around the treaded robot with small amplitude at normal speed while it spins a scoop arm, gathers snow without stopping, and hurls a return throw in the same motion. A hydraulic hiss escapes its shoulder joint. [Shot 4] At 00:11.500, the shot cuts to a wide shot as snowballs cross the field in both directions. The tripod robot leaps on its three legs, dodging one ball that shatters on the snow behind it, while the bulky piston-shouldered unit takes a direct hit to the chest and topples backward into a drift, legs folding. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed, revealing all four robots spread across the churned snow, servos whirring, until the bulky unit pushes itself up onto one elbow and the others turn toward it.

overall_soundscape: Powder snow crunches and squeaks under metal feet and treads, layered with constant servo whirs, joint clicks, and short hydraulic hisses. Snowballs strike plating with hollow thuds and burst into soft powder impacts, while brief electronic chirps and buzzing synthesized laughter pass between the robots.

non_diegetic_music: Playful pizzicato strings over light hand percussion at a moderate tempo, joined by a rising woodwind line as the throws quicken, then a single accented hit on the final impact before the music thins to a few sparse plucked notes.

source_prompt: Characters from famous paintings step out of their frames into a snowy world, throwing snowballs at each other.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic with a painterly finish, a wide shot frames an open snowfield where three gilded picture frames stand upright in the drift like doorways, their canvases replaced by falling snow. Snowflakes drift past the carved gold edges as a woman in a dark Renaissance gown with folded hands, a young woman in a blue headscarf wearing a single pearl earring, and a man in a fur-trimmed red cloak and white ruff step down from their frames one after another, boots sinking into the powder. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as they glance at one another and scoop snow from the ground. [Shot 2] At 00:02.100, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of the young woman in the blue headscarf packing a snowball between her palms; she draws her arm back and hurls it. The camera pans right with fast speed as the white ball crosses the open field. [Shot 3] At 00:03.800, the shot switches to a wide static shot as the snowball bursts against the shoulder of the man in the red cloak, powder spraying across his fur collar. He staggers back one step, ducks behind a gilded frame, and lobs a return throw while the woman in the dark gown crouches and laughs, snow dusting her sleeves.

overall_soundscape: Wind hisses steadily across the snowfield while hard-packed snow crunches underfoot and the standing wooden frames creak in the cold. A snowball leaves the woman's hands with a soft fabric whoosh, bursts on the cloaked man's shoulder with a muffled thump, and is followed by low laughter and the wet sound of snow being packed again.

non_diegetic_music: Plucked strings at a quick tempo with a light triangle pulse underneath; a short harp glissando follows the snowball's flight and the ensemble cuts off at the moment of impact before resuming.

source_prompt: A couple runs through a sudden downpour, laughing and splashing in puddles as they try to find shelter.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide street-level view frames a rain-blurred city avenue at dusk, with shop signs, parked cars, and pedestrians holding open umbrellas. A heavy downpour breaks open within the first second, and a young couple in their late twenties — the woman in a mustard-yellow raincoat, the man in a soaked grey hoodie — sprint hand in hand along the wet sidewalk, dodging umbrella spokes. The camera tracks right at fast speed alongside them as their shoes slap the flooded pavement and spray kicks up around their ankles. The woman (S1), laughing breathlessly, calls out over the rain: <d>[English] This way, come on!</d> The man (S2), grinning and out of breath, answers: <d>[English] I'm right behind you!</d> Water streams off their hair and shoulders as they run toward a row of awnings ahead. [Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the shot cuts to a low-angle tracking shot at ground level, gliding through standing water as their feet pound straight through a wide puddle, throwing a sheet of muddy water sideways. The camera tilts up with large amplitude at fast speed to catch them from behind, still joined at the hand, the woman's yellow coat flapping, the man hopping a flooded gutter. She laughs so hard she stumbles half a step, then pulls him forward again, both of them splashing in unison through the deepening water as a bus hisses past in a wall of spray. [Shot 3] At 00:09.500, the shot cuts to a medium two-shot under the green awning of a corner bookshop, where rain sheets off the fabric edge in a steady curtain. The couple skids to a halt beneath it, chests heaving, water dripping from their hair onto the dry concrete. The man (S2) leans against the shopfront, pushes wet hair off his forehead and says, still laughing: <d>[English] I told you it never rains here.</d> The woman (S1) laughs and shakes the water off her sleeve, and they turn to each other, breathless and grinning, as the downpour keeps drumming on the awning above them until the final frame.

overall_soundscape: Heavy rain pounds the pavement, car roofs, and the awning canvas with a constant low hiss underneath. Running footfalls slap through standing water with large wet splashes, and passing traffic swishes through the flooded street. Breathless laughter, panting, and short gasps come from the couple as they run and finally slide to a stop.

non_diegetic_music: Bright handclaps and fast pizzicato strings at a quick tempo, joined by a warm bass line that rises while the couple runs and softens into a sustained low note once they reach the awning.

source_prompt: In the middle of a rainy street, one person shares an umbrella with another, leading to a moment of connection as they walk together through the rain.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a rain-soaked city street after dusk, with wet asphalt reflecting blurred amber streetlights and steady rain streaking through the air. On the left side of the frame, a young woman in a soaked olive jacket stands at the curb with her arms crossed over her chest, rain flattening her dark hair. From the right, a man in a grey coat walks toward her beneath a wide black umbrella. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed as he slows his steps beside her, tilts the umbrella shaft toward her so the canopy covers them both, and pauses. Water drips from the umbrella's edge onto the pavement; she lifts her head, glances at the space beside him, then steps in under the canopy and falls into step with him. [Shot 2] At 00:02.800, the shot cuts to a closer, horizontally composed view from the side as the two of them walk together through the rain, the black umbrella tilted between them so that their shoulders nearly touch. The camera tracks alongside them at normal speed while their wet shoes strike shallow puddles in rhythm and the beam of a passing car sweeps across the wet storefronts behind them. The young woman with a soft, slightly breathless voice (S1) says: <d>[English] I think this is my stop.</d> The man turns his head toward her and smiles without speaking as they continue walking out of the frame past the final moment.

overall_soundscape: Rain falls steadily on the pavement, on car roofs, and on the umbrella canopy, with distant tires hissing over wet asphalt and a low city hum underneath. Footsteps splash lightly through shallow puddles in a steady rhythm, and the umbrella fabric ripples as it is tilted.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse piano notes at a slow tempo over a sustained low string pad, joined by a warm rising cello line in the second half before fading out.

source_prompt: llamas are kicking a soccer ball
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot frames a sunlit Andean pasture with dry golden grass and distant snow-capped peaks under a clear blue sky. Three shaggy llamas with mixed white and brown fleece stand in a loose triangle, ears swiveling toward a scuffed black-and-white soccer ball resting in the grass between them. The tallest llama plants its front hooves, rocks back, and swings a foreleg into the ball with a hard thump. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed as the ball skids low across the grass, flattening a path through the blades, and the other two llamas pivot on their hind legs to chase it, necks lowered and fleece bouncing with each stride. [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle close-up just above the turf as the rolling ball meets the flat edge of the lead llama's hoof. The camera tracks the ball with large amplitude at fast speed, tilting up as the impact lifts it off the ground; dirt clods and shredded grass scatter past the lens, and the ball climbs against the bright sky, spinning so its black patches blur into gray. The llama lifts its head to follow the arc, ears pinned back, breath steaming in the cold highland air. [Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot at ground level as the ball lands, bounces twice, and rolls to a stop near a flat gray rock. The camera arcs clockwise around the group at slow speed while the smallest llama trots in from the left, skids to a halt with its hooves tearing up a patch of grass, and nudges the ball with its muzzle, rolling it a half-turn forward. The other two llamas close in behind it and stand still, heads lowered toward the ball, tails flicking once as a light wind pushes dust across the pasture in the final seconds.

overall_soundscape: A dry wind hisses steadily across the open pasture and through the llamas' fleece. Hooves thud and skid against packed earth and grass, the ball leaves with a flat thump and then a softer bouncing tap, and the llamas emit low hums, a short grunt, and heavy nasal breathing as they run.

non_diegetic_music: A brisk acoustic guitar and charango pattern at a moderate tempo, joined by hand percussion and a low pan-flute melody that rises slightly in volume during the ball's flight and settles back down as it rolls to a stop.

source_prompt: A squirrel wearing a tiny aviator hat and goggles, piloting a miniature airplane through a park.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide tracking shot follows a miniature cream-and-red biplane buzzing low between the trunks of a sunlit park, a small squirrel in a brown leather aviator hat and brass goggles seated in the open cockpit with both front paws gripping the control stick. The camera tracks the plane from the side with small amplitude at fast speed as its propeller blurs and the aircraft banks right around a thick oak, its wingtip skimming the leaves; a red scarf tied at the squirrel's neck streams backward in the slipstream. [Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to a low angle close-up over a park pond as the biplane swoops down across the water, the squirrel leaning forward in the cockpit, its tail lifted and its cheeks puffed by the wind. Ripples spread across the surface beneath the wheels, and the squirrel lets out a rapid chattering squeak, then pulls the stick back; the plane climbs steeply, levels off over a checkered picnic blanket, and glides away toward the treeline.

overall_soundscape: A steady high-pitched propeller buzz and rushing wind accompany the aircraft throughout, layered over park ambience of rustling leaves and distant birdsong. The plane's engine rises in pitch during the dive, water ripples softly beneath the wheels, and the squirrel emits quick chattering squeaks.

non_diegetic_music: A brisk ukulele and plucked-string pattern at a moderate tempo, joined by light snare taps and rising brass notes during the climb before a short sustained chord at the end.

source_prompt: A cat sitting at a grand piano, elegantly playing a classical piece with its paws.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide static shot frames a black-and-white tuxedo cat sitting upright on a tufted velvet piano bench in a dim drawing room, its front paws resting on the ivory keys of a polished black grand piano while warm late-afternoon light from tall windows rakes across the lacquered lid. The cat lifts its right paw, presses a single key, then its left, and begins playing a flowing classical melody at a steady walking tempo, head held high and body still. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the cat's tail sweeps in time beside the bench, and an open score on the music stand shows the printed words "Allegro con brio". [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a close-up from the side of the keyboard, framing the cat's two front paws as they travel across the keys in quick ascending runs, claws sheathed, toe pads landing cleanly. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed along the length of the keyboard, keeping the paws in frame as they cross into the lower register; the cat's ears swivel back toward the soundboard and its whiskers flick with each accented note. [Shot 3] At 00:09.800, the shot cuts to a low wide angle from the far end of the room, showing the whole piano, the cat, and the sunlit floor. The cat sits taller, leans back slightly, raises both front paws together, and brings them down on a full closing chord; it holds the keys as the sound swells, releases them, then lowers its paws to the wood and settles motionless on the bench, tail curling around its body, holding that pose through the final moment.

overall_soundscape: A quiet drawing room carries a soft room tone with faint birdsong and distant street noise drifting through the windows. The piano bench creaks slightly under shifting weight, the sustain pedal thumps gently against its stop, and the key mechanism clicks softly beneath the notes. The cat breathes steadily through its nose and gives one low, rumbling purr near the end as its tail brushes the bench.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

source_prompt: A dog dressed as a chef, expertly flipping pancakes in a kitchen.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium shot frames a golden retriever wearing a white chef's coat and a tall pleated toque, standing on a low wooden step stool at a stainless-steel kitchen counter. The dog grips a black-handled frying pan in its front paws, tips the pan forward with a quick wrist-like snap, and launches a round pancake high into the air above the counter. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the pancake turns over, golden-brown and bubbling at the edges, while the dog's ears lift and its gaze tracks the arc upward. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of the pan as the pancake drops back onto the hot surface with a soft slap. A puff of steam and melted butter spatters sideways, the dog's furry paw tightens on the handle, and the pancake settles flat and centered in the pan as the dog gives a single satisfied tail wag that swings into frame at the right edge.

overall_soundscape: Butter sizzles steadily in the hot pan over a low kitchen ventilation hum. A soft slap sounds as the pancake lands back on the metal, followed by light spattering and the quick tap of the dog's claws on the stool and a gentle tail thump.

non_diegetic_music: An upbeat jazz trio at a moderate tempo, with brushed drums, walking upright bass, and short muted trumpet phrases that end on a light accent as the pancake lands.

source_prompt: A rabbit in a magician's outfit, pulling a human-sized carrot out of a top hat.
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a small vaudeville stage where a waist-high black lacquered table stands in the center beneath deep red velvet curtains and a warm overhead spotlight. A white rabbit in a magician's outfit — a black tailcoat with a red-lined cape, a black bow tie, and white gloves — stands upright on its hind legs on the polished wooden floorboards, its long ears twitching. A black top hat sits on the table, and the rabbit lifts a white-tipped wand in one paw. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the rabbit taps the wand three times against the hat's brim, swishes it in a wide arc, and the confident, slightly squeaky showman rabbit (S1) announces: <d>[English] And now, ladies and gentlemen, the impossible!</d> The rabbit's nose wrinkles as it grips the brim with both gloved paws. [Shot 2] At 00:05.200, the camera cuts to a close-up of the hat's opening, where the black interior is squeezing and bulging from the inside. The rabbit's paws clamp down on the brim and pull upward with a visible strain, its front teeth gritted and its ears tilted back, while the table legs scrape a few centimeters across the floorboards under the hat's wobble. A faint orange edge pushes against the rim from below, and the hat's felt stretches with a low creak as the rabbit leans its whole body backward. [Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a wider angle as the rabbit hops backward and drags a human-sized carrot out of the hat, the thick green leafy crown emerging first. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed as the enormous orange root slides free, tips forward, and lands flat on the stage with a heavy thud that shakes the table. The rabbit drops the wand, plants both paws on its hips, and the same showman rabbit (S1) shouts, <d>[English] Voilà!</d> before sweeping into a low bow with its cape flaring and its ears brushing the floorboards.

overall_soundscape: A hushed theater ambience with faint coughs and shifting seats surrounds the stage, punctuated by three sharp taps of the wand on felt. Heavy grey clouds churn overhead, bare branches thrash along the pavement, and brown water races along the gutter past corrugated-iron shopfronts. A green street sign reading "Vilakazi Street" swings and creaks on the corner. In the middle distance an old man in a loose green dress and a wide-brimmed straw sun hat strolls without any hurry, shoulders relaxed, his long skirt swinging as he steps straight through a shallow puddle. The camera tracks right at slow speed, keeping him centred as the wind pushes rain sideways across the frame. [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a medium tracking shot at his side as a gust snaps the hem of the green dress out sideways and lifts the brim of his sun hat off his forehead. He presses the hat down with one hand, keeps walking, and grins, the old man with a warm, gravelly voice and a slow Johannesburg drawl (S1) says: <d>[English] Best weather for a walk, this.</d> Raindrops run down the shoulders of his dress as he continues at the same unhurried pace. [Shot 3] At 00:09.500, the shot cuts to a low-angle close shot from the wet pavement, framing his shoes splashing through the water and the soaked hem of the dress dragging behind them. The camera tilts up at slow speed past rain beading and dripping from the sun hat brim to his face, where he tips the brim with two fingers toward someone off-screen, then hums a low tune to himself as he steps over the rushing gutter stream. [Shot 4] At 00:12.500, the shot cuts to a wide shot from behind as he walks away down the flooded street, small in the frame between bare trees and shop windows that throw back his reflection. The camera pedestals up with small amplitude at slow speed while he keeps strolling through the storm, hat and green dress dark with rain, until he reaches the far end of the street and continues out of frame at the end of the video.

overall_soundscape: A hard winter wind roars through bare branches and rattles the street sign overhead. Rain drums steadily on corrugated-iron roofs, water rushes and gurgles along the gutter, and his shoes slap through puddles with a wet squeak. Fabric snaps and flaps in the gusts, distant thunder rolls once, a hooter sounds far away, and his low chuckle and soft humming sit close to the microphone.

non_diegetic_music: A jaunty, old-fashioned tune in a steady marching rhythm, carried by banjo, muted trumpet and brushed snare, with a light tuba pulse underneath. The volume rises slightly as he speaks and stays warm and even until it fades out over the final steps.

overall_soundscape: A steady polar wind hisses across the snow, ruffling fabric and the hat brim. Boots crunch and squeak rhythmically over packed ice, with a brief pause in the footsteps during the close-up, followed by a soft satisfied sigh and one more distant gust.

non_diegetic_music: Gentle fingerpicked acoustic guitar at a slow tempo, joined by warm sustained strings that swell slightly during the close-up before easing off.

The old man with a warm, gravelly voice (S1) says: <d>[English] Now this is a proper holiday.</d> He lifts the brim of his sun hat with one hand and lets it settle back. He stops in front of a painted ice whale, and as a group of children in bright parkas runs past, the smallest child (S2) shouts over the crowd, <d>[English] Great hat, mister!</d> The old man laughs and calls back, <d>[English] Thank you, young explorer.</d> The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed on his smiling face as the wind lifts the brim of his sun hat and a strand of white hair. [Shot 3] At 00:09.500, the camera arcs around him at slow speed from his front to his side as glittering confetti snow drifts down through the lantern light. He spreads both arms, spins once so the green dress flares across the frame, then tips his sun hat toward the applauding crowd. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed until the festival bunting, glowing sculptures, and clustered visitors surround him again, and he walks away along the snow path toward the lantern line with his back to the camera, the dress swaying with each step as the ice plain brightens behind him.

overall_soundscape: A steady polar wind moves across the open ice while bunting and flags snap and flutter overhead. Boots crunch and squeak on packed snow, laughter and scattered applause rise from the festival crowd, and the old man hums two soft notes under his breath before the wind carries them off.

non_diegetic_music: A brisk accordion melody at a moderate tempo, supported by light hand percussion on the offbeats. Warm low strings enter as he spins and swell in volume through the pull-out, then thin out to a single sustained accordion note.

overall_soundscape: A constant howling wind sweeps across the ice with a low, hollow roar and a thin whistling pitch through the gusts.
